narrative.overview:
A calm, commercial, light-ground site played straight at full craft: near-white paper, ink type, hairline rules that read like ledger lines, and a single tangerine accent that is used large or as a thin underline, never as wallpaper. A dark ink band closes the page at the contact section. The page is a journey told in order, so the structure is rows, rules and a vertical timeline rather than cards.

Density is generous: sections breathe with 72-128px vertical padding, copy holds to a 64ch measure, and hierarchy comes from the Bricolage display face against a quiet Hanken body, not from boxes or shadows. Motion is soft and purposeful: content rises into place once, an underline sweeps under one word in the headline, and a dot field reacts to the cursor.

The system rejects the dark, monospace, typewriter developer-resume look.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white ground, ink type, one tangerine accent, warm-grey bands for alternation.
Hairline 1px rules and 1px ink rules at the top of lists carry structure.
Two grotesque faces: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Hanken Grotesk for everything else.
Flat at rest; shadow only on the floating "now" card and the work screenshot.
Dark ink contact band and footer as the single inverted zone.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Tangerine is the only chromatic accent. It appears large (a word, a node, a bar) or as a thin line; it never fills big surfaces and never carries small text on the light ground (use Burnt Tangerine Ink).

rules.name: The Ink Band Rule
rules.body: The only dark region is the contact section and footer. Everything above it stays light.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display faces carry negative tracking (-0.02 to -0.035em) and balanced wrapping; body text never does.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, and tags are sentence case. No uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Shadows are soft, large-blur, and reserved for the two overlapping or framed media objects above.

dos: Do keep tangerine (#F24E0A) large or thin; switch to #A5320A for any accent text on the light ground.
Do build lists as ruled rows with a 1px ink top rule and hairline separators.
Do use Bricolage for headings, labels in display contexts, and the wordmark; Hanken for all running text and UI labels.
Do use the single spring-out ease and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep the 64ch measure on paragraphs and 3px tangerine focus rings on every interactive element.
Do keep the contact section and footer as the only dark zone.
donts: Don't drift to dark, monospace, or terminal styling on the light sections.
Don't fill large surfaces with tangerine or add a second accent hue.
Don't add shadows to ordinary rows or cards; hairlines do that job.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels or other small-caps-style headings above sections.
Don't round beyond the scale above or mix border widths beyond 1px (2px only for spine, underlines, nodes).
